comments.author: dement
comments.body_html:
I personally find the “slat” type rear sights to be very hard to center, I saw in another reply you said you’re okay with the ‘open top’ rearsights as they are but to me, stuff like the mosin, AKs, gornostay, etc. have near solid rear sights and it only ever even remotely becomes usable when zoomed in via FOVfix.

I’m not asking for too big a change like it is with this mod, just widening them to fit the front post with enough clearance to allow a bit of light bleed, without the two sights overlapping when sitting completely still would do wonders.

Could even just make them taper outwards so its easier to see the center when looking at the rear sight alone, like an upside down triangle.

like absolute worst case, if you really don’t want to edit the models, maybe at least we could get some markings in the middle of the rear sights similar to (but pls not as ugly as) those yellow dot mods for the AK sights but universal..

I really wanna be able to do more naked gun builds in the game but the iron sights really ruin it for me for 90% of the guns, your work on these ‘circular sight’ guns are already amazing, I doubt you’d mess it up with the others.
